newsitem.title: BULGARIA: BULGARIA M1 UP 0.13 PCT, M2 RISES 0.34 PCT IN WEEK.
newsitem.headline: BULGARIA M1 UP 0.13 PCT, M2 RISES 0.34 PCT IN WEEK.

text.p: Bulgarian M1 money supply inched up to 148.7 billion levs on October 18 from 148.5 billion levs on October 11 and M2 edged up to 792.9 billion levs from 790.2 billion levs, reliminary central bank figures showed.

Total broad money rose by 0.49 percent to 825.2 billion levs as lev-denominated broad money increased by 1.02 percent to 496.6 billion levs and dollar-denominated broad money inched down 0.30 percent to 328.9 billion levs.
Hard currency-denominated deposits of companies and individuals totalled $1.385 billion on October 18, down $22 million from October 11.
Lev-denominated term deposits of companies and individuals rose to 291 billion levs on October 18 from 287 billion levs a week earlier. -- Sofia Newsroom, 359-2-84561
